content: Ɓakuli tunǝ Ibǝram
Mǝtalabangŋo ne Ibǝram ama, <<Purî nzali ma'wun, puro nying aɓwana mô, andǝ ɓala mala tárró. O a nzali mǝnana mǝ nǝ lǝmdǝo wi ka.

content.text: <<Mǝ nǝ tsǝo awu nǝ duk nzali mala aɓwapǝndǝa mǝ'làkke.
mǝ nǝ tsǝa lullǝo nǝ̀ zǝkya,
sǝ awu nǝ duk mǝgulo kǝ̀rkǝ́r.
Nǝbano sǝ aɓwana nǝ̀ kum tsǝkbu.
Aɓwana mǝnana à tsǝko bù ka,
sǝ aɓwana mǝnana à suio ka, mǝ nǝ suia.
Sǝ atau mala aɓwapǝndǝa kat a ɓanza ka,

content: Ibǝram bwal njargula o kǝla mǝnana Mǝtalabangŋo banggi wi ka; Lotu gbal ka o atè. Ibǝram nǝ̀ nying nzali Haran ngga, ndanǝ apǝlǝa lumi-tongno-nong-ɓari nǝ mǝsǝì tongno (75).
Ibǝram twal māmí Sarayi andǝ mǝkine Lotu andǝ gǝna malea mǝnana kat à ram ngga, andǝ aɓwapǝndǝa mǝnana à ndanǝi a Haran ngga, sǝ à bwal njargula aban o a nzali Kan'ana. Lang à bingŋǝna ka,
Ibǝram gya arǝ aban aɓa nzali Kan'ana yi bwal Shekem. A banì ka tsǝk gumli a tǝ́r ɓe nggun mǝgule mana à tunǝki ama nggun Moreh ka. A mǝno yì bàkú ka amǝ'Kan'ana nakam nǝdo a nzalinì.
Mǝtalabangŋo pusǝrǝi aban Ibǝram, sǝ ne wi ama, <<Nzali mǝnia a sǝngiyi ka, mǝ nǝ pè amunio andǝ amǝ'keò.>> Pǝlǝa Ibǝram ɓak gyangŋan kàm ace Mǝtalabangŋo, mǝnana pusǝrǝi a baní ka.

Ibǝram loapi Shekem, twal gya o a nzali múr ankono a takuli mala là Betel. Kya tsǝk gumli male a ɓè ban mǝnana Betel na a bui mala njar-nzali, sǝ là Ai ka nda a bui mala njar-takuli ka. A ban mǝno ka Ibǝram nyare ɓak gyangŋan ace Mǝtalabangŋo, sǝ peri aban Mǝtalabangŋo.
Ibǝram nyare lo lidǝmba nǝ gya, kǝ turki arǝ abân bǝti-bǝti, tsǝk múrí nǝ̀ ká a Negev.
Ibǝram andǝ Sarayi a Masar
Nzala yi kpa aɓa nzali Kan'ana. Nzalè ɓiki pa kǝ̀rkǝ́r nda Ibǝram lo nǝ̀ o a nzali Masar nǝ̀ nggá duk kam bǝti.
Lang malanǝ̀ kùtí a Masar ka, banggi māmí Sarayi ama, <<Sǝni pé, ǝn sǝlǝna ama a nda ɓwama nggea mǝɓoarnsari.
Ɓǝ̀ aɓwana mǝnana a Masar sǝno ka, à nǝ̀ na ama a nda māmám; pǝlǝa à nǝ̀ wal-luem ace mǝnana à nǝ̀ twalo wu duk malea ka.
Acemani ka, ida, banggia wia ama a nda mǝkyauwem; sǝ atàcau mò ka à nǝ̀ ɗekiǎm nǝ yilǝmu sǝ à nǝ̀ pakkam mǝɓoarne.>>
Lang Ibǝram yina aɓa nzali Masar ka, amǝ Masar sǝn Sarayi ka ɓwama nggea mǝɓoarnsari na.
Lang amǝ tamurǝm Masar sǝni ka, à kya bang cau mala ɓoarnsari male aban Firona, murǝm malea. Nda à yiu à yi twal Sarayi à umnǝi a ɓala-murǝm.
Murǝm pakki Ibǝram mǝɓoarne atàcau mala Sarayi; pè Ibǝram anzur, andá, adambǝritso jamne andǝ amamǝne, amǝ'túró-ɓala aburana andǝ amamǝna, andǝ akalakadambi.
Sǝ acemǝnana murǝm Firona twal Sarayi, mālá Ibǝram ngga, Mǝtalabangŋo tasǝ nggea kwánó mǝɓike amur murǝm Firona andǝ amǝɓala male.
Acemani ka, murǝm Firona túrban à tunǝ Ibǝram, sǝ banggi wi ama, <<Mana mǝnia a pakkam ngga? Mana tsǝa sǝ a ɓinǝ banggàm ama yi ka māmó na.
Palang sǝ a bang ama yi ka mǝ'kyauweo na, sǝ mǝno ka tsǝa ǝn twali ɓǝ̀ duk māmám? Ado ka māmó nya ka. Twali sǝ wu o!>>
Pǝlǝa murǝm Firona tasǝ aburana male nǝ cau amur Ibǝram, sǝ à kya pusǝì purî ɓá nzali Masar, yì andǝ māmí andǝ koman mana kat male na ka.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Tite 15:7; Atúró 7:3; Ib 11:8.
